newsitem.title: USA: POLK AUDIO IN LICENSING AGREEMENT WITH KEP.
newsitem.headline: POLK AUDIO IN LICENSING AGREEMENT WITH KEP.

text.p: Polk Audio Inc said Friday that it has signed a licensing agreement with KEP, a Korean supplier of speakers to Samsung Corp, to incorporate some of its designs and technology in two models of Samsung televisions.
These technologies, said the company, include a patented bass venting technology, which was also recently licensed to Hewlett-Packard Co for use in computer speakers.
Polk said it expects to begin making these units in October, and is also in talks to add other television set models to the program.
It added that the parties are also negotiating to add other television models to the program.
